title: Twitter and Visual Studio Rant
summary: Casey Muratori responds on-stream to a dismissive Twitter post by demonstrating how slow Visual Studio's startup and debugger watch window are, comparing it to much older software and machines. It is a long rant about software performance and bloat.
why: HN commenters cite it as the canonical concrete demonstration that modern developer tools got slower despite vastly faster hardware.

quote.text: Casey Muratori has some great YouTube videos (a.k.a.: rants)
